title: The Death of Amrito
subtitle: A Village Shrouded in Secrets and Shadows
summary: When Byomkesh Bakshi arrives in the remote village of Baghmari, tangled secrets linger in the dense forest and among its tight-knit residents. As rumors of hidden arms and wartime legacies swirl, a mysterious death plunges the community into suspicion and fear. Join India's iconic detective as he unravels a chilling mystery where every villager could be a suspect.
